work.description: The exact selected raw OCR extent and surrounding boundary context were inspected. Printed attribution is preserved; this is not modern authentication, critical dating or image-collated text. Independent DCXIII 90876, synopsis 90879–90886 and self-protocol 90888–90889 follow preceding dating 90869–90873. The earlier Urbanus letter is explicitly introduced as quoted tenor 90891–90894; its source-abbreviated incipit Alias felicis...etc and ensuing recital run to 90943, before the present petition at §2 90945 and operative §§3–4. Dating 91028–91032 closes this act before next DCXIV 91035. Own notes 90901–90903 and 90953–90954 are retained. The earlier letter's printed abbreviation remains source wording and does not create a separate candidate or an invented completion; no body reversal found.
